name: LaunchBrowserNode
label: Launch Browser
description: Launches a web browser instance of Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: BrowserType
fields.label: Browser Type
fields.description: Specifies which browser to launch (Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome).

fields.name: LaunchUrl
fields.label: Launch Url
fields.description: The URL to launch the browser with. If empty, the browser will launch without navigating to a specific page.

fields.name: BrowsingMode
fields.label: Browsing Mode
fields.description: Specifies whether to open in normal or private mode.

fields.name: WindowState
fields.label: Window State
fields.description: Specifies the initial browser window state.

selectOptions.label: Maximized
selectOptions.description: Launches browser in maximized window state.

selectOptions.label: Minimized
selectOptions.description: Launches browser in minimized window state.
